profile.headline: Senior Technologist doing all things software development related
profile.summary:
I'm a developer, an engineer, a devops practitioner, a team player, and a leader that is capable of connecting and communicating with different people and different audiences. 

I have been developing technical solutions since 2007.  Some tech I'm familiar with:

.NET, .NET Core, .NET MVC, Web API, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Angular, SQL, various Azure services including Azure Pipelines, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, various AWS Services, Lambdas, API Gateway, EC2, S3, Various CI/CDs such as Jenkins, Azure Pipelines, Concourse, CircleCI, TeamCity, and many others technologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I am on a team that develops and maintains several modern, event-driven microservices for various public-facing and non-public-facing websites. A suite of services were developed to empower customers to be able to reserve vehicles, transfer vehicles to their local stores, summarize customer activities and recommend the next step in their car shopping journey.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET · Microsoft Azure · Azure DevOps Services · Azure Cosmos DB · Azure Functions · Azure

positions.title: Senior Manager
positions.description:
Some experiences include...

Working on a development team at an Automotive Retail Company.  Implemented an event driven API architecture hosted on a hybrid Azure cloud environment, utilizing devops best practices and scrum methodologies. February 2021 - Present


Worked on a DevSecOps team at a major telecommunications company in the Philadelphia area. Coached development teams on setting up security tools as part of their software development cycle. Educating teams on different tools, security coverage, and examine code vulnerabilities.  January 2019 - May 2020


Implemented APIs for website consumption and system integration at a New Jersey American owned Food and Beverage company. June 2015 - June 2018
